Prepare a Parquet corpus for serving

Source: R/corpus.R
prepare_corpus.Rd

Reads all Parquet files below corpus into one DuckDB database file: one row per work (duplicates across partitions removed), with helper columns for ID and DOI matching and the abstract as text. The database is cached and reused while the corpus files are unchanged (same paths, sizes and modification times).

Usage

prepare_corpus(
  corpus,
  rebuild = FALSE,
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("openalexAPI", "cache")
)

Arguments

corpus

Directory with the corpus Parquet files (searched recursively).

rebuild

Rebuild the database even if a cached one exists.

cache_dir

Where the database files are kept.

Value

The path of the DuckDB database file, invisibly.

Details

The corpus can come from openalexPro::pro_request_parquet() (keeps abstract_inverted_index and adds abstract), from the JSONL path (only abstract), from a snapshot extraction, or from any source with the OpenAlex works schema. Hive partition columns are not read.
